timeline.summary: Mikey introduces his family and childhood, then describes early confidence, schooling and severe adolescent acne.
He recounts shame, avoidance, bullying, a long crush, anonymous drawings and a friend's disclosure that led to peer ridicule.
He describes rejection, vocational/college years, heavy gaming, basketball and fitness peers, and beginning to seek relationship advice.
He recounts early courses, hospital acne treatment, apps, hairstyle changes and deceptive luxury/status photos that failed when offline reality did not match.
He contrasts canned techniques with a more natural approach model, narrates first street attempts and increasingly high-volume exposure.
He discusses rapid-kiss games, failed or unhealthy relationships, alleged betrayal and later mentor feedback; consent and third-party claims remain high risk.
He claims improved sexual/dating outcomes, became a coach, faced criticism and started his YouTube channel; outcomes are self-report.
He closes by urging action, medical care for skin problems, exercise and professional relationship help, then promotes contact channels.

visual_findings: All 68 sampled frames were reviewed. The edit combines a studio monologue with childhood/family photos, acne selfies, game imagery, social posts, approach footage, relationship images, mentors/events and later career photos.
A QR/contact overlay is present throughout much of the video, making the autobiography partly promotional.
Some third parties, posts and relationship images are visible; identity, privacy and publication consent cannot be established from the samples.
The images support broad autobiographical staging but not medical diagnosis, alleged betrayal, number of partners, sexual outcomes or coaching effectiveness.

permissions.reason: Distinct source, but autobiography is mixed with medical anecdotes, trauma causality, third-party allegations, nonconsensual-risk tactics and unverified sexual/promotional outcomes.

limitations: Automatic transcript was not checked word-for-word against original audio.
Sixty-eight sparse frames do not equal continuous audio-visual verification.
Dates, medical history, schooling, relationships, partner conduct and sexual outcomes are personal recollection without primary documentation.
Photographs and posts may expose third parties; consent to reuse is unknown.
